answer: Each identity locks 70 credits in a vault for a wharf milestone, verifying a manifest. A wharf auditor stamps each milestone with a key-bound ivory receipt. Three milestones unlock the vault; rented receipts burn the bond. Fees rise per identity under one key: first 35, k-th 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000, lock 70,000, for 40,000. Bought ivory receipts carry another key; the ring fails. Honest agents pay 35 once; bond returns.
